svg.title: Maknae tool invocation
svg.desc: UML sequence diagram of one tool call for any tool, each step marked live, unreachable or with the issue that builds it: the catalog and the menu, the model's invoke, an in-kernel verb decided and performed by maknaed, or a container tool decided first with a deny exit, its credential, the launch helper starting the container with the sandbox baseline, each network connection decided through maknae-proxy, and the output filtered, zeroized, recorded and released to the model.
svg.text: One tool call: who decides, who launches it, what it reaches, what the model sees
Any tool, the same steps for a person's maknae and for maknae-agentd working a task. A task changes only the inputs: the uid, the workspace, bindings and reach, the credential.

An in-kernel verb is live today; a container tool is decided first, gets its credential (generated-tool-credentials.svg) and is launched by the launch helper. Each step shows its build state, or the issue that builds it.
sees: tool names and shapes, never a credential
3. «live» invoke a tool by name with
citing the task when there is one
5. «live» decide and perform it; a denied read is recorded and answered unavailable
sees: file content the subject may read; sensitive.yaml paths refused
8. «unreachable» resolve and render; a slot or argv refusal stops before the PDP
9. «unreachable» decide tool.invoke: containment, the tools.yaml ceiling, the role, Tool grants
10. «#168» in a task: the shape's forge needs lie within the task's reach
11. «#479» the workspace's credential bundle ∩ what the subject holds
12. «unreachable» decide the workspace mount; denies become the mask set
23. «unreachable» filter the output for every delivered value; on a match, withhold it
«live» built, reachable in production · «unreachable» built, no production caller · «decided» in an ADR, not built · «#N» planned in that issue
maknae-agentd refetches when a TaskClaim reply's digest changes; maknae fetches on demand (maknae tools). The catalog is a hint and never authority.
Today the model is offered the six file tools and task_agent only. Every crossing to the model travels in a model turn through maknaed and egress (generated-credential-path.svg).
Live for the file tools and task_agent. A container tool's invoke carries an entry, a shape and slot values, never an option (#479, ADR-0036 decision 21).
A person cites no task, so no bindings or reach; an agent cites its task. Bindings on session.new for a person's own session are #479.
The request carries maknae-security labels like every other request (ADR-0037 decision 8), so RBAC applies now and a labeling or DCS engine can plug in later (#147).
The tool-call path stamps reach.git.base and reach.git.head on the request; nothing reads them. #168 PR C adds the refusal.

Person: current or path, never home or above. Agent: within its tasker's partition; pinning it to the task's own directory is #476. Ruled 2026-11-27, not built (#479): noexec when executes_workspace is false.

The helper is the only thing that talks to the runtime: rootless Podman by default; Docker or containerd by site choice; a MaknaeRuntimeClass on Kubernetes. A rootful runtime warns loudly at every start.
Read-only root, non-root, no capabilities, no-new-privileges, the runtime's default seccomp; scratch tmpfs noexec,nosuid,nodev; Landlock where the host has it.
The container's only route: an internal network and a relay in the rootless network namespace (measured 2026-11-18).
Content-blind: the proxy sees host and port only, so content checks do not run on tool traffic (#147).

Built: the value filter withholds an output that matches a delivered value, as raw bytes, hex, percent-encoding, or base64 (standard and URL-safe, at three alignments), and 16-byte fragments of the plaintext. Only EnvVar slots are indexed; line-wrapped base64, xxd-style hex and JSON escapes are not matched (ADR-0026). No tool front end screens output with it yet (#479); the revoke on a match needs #168 PR C.
The release is a kernel decision. Category detection is not built, so tool output counts as unmarked (#147).
